text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Electoral campaign intensifies as the June 5 historical deadline gets near.
- Algeria and China sign scientific cooperation accord on nuclear research.
- U.S. group Pfeizer to build $25 million factory for manufacturing medicines in Algeria.
- As electoral campaign proceeds political parties call for massive participation.
- Prominent party leaders lead the campaign at the expense of less known candidates.
- Algeria ready to cooperate with Congo's new authorities.
